## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing and `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] `go test ./... -short` passes
- [ ] If I touched the grader or content: `go test ./...` passes (full suite, needs the language toolchains)
- [ ] Content changes keep reference solutions grading green (the native round-trip gate)
- [ ] Commits are focused with clear messages
